City lists APN 726-13-049, not in the county parcel layer.

State report (2023-2025): 49 building permit rows named The Lumberyard, all single-family attached, owner tenure, no deed-restricted units. Permits by date: 8 on 2023-05-25, 9 on 2023-06-27, 8 on 2024-12-19, 11 on 2025-05-15, 9 on 2025-05-28, 4 on 2025-08-04. Certificates of occupancy: 4 on 2025-12-19, 1 on 2025-12-29.

Initial Study (August 2019): project sponsor Paul Latala, The Latala Group, LLC, Campbell; site APNs 726-13-049 and 726-13-052; parcel to be split into two lots, Lot 1 with 33 units and Lot 2 with 16 units and the office space; two existing buildings demolished.
County parcel layer shows parcels 726-61-001 through 726-61-050 with Depot St and E Dunne Ave situs addresses at the project site.
